name: document-library
title: Document library
description: Downloadable documents grouped by category: format, size, pages, language and date on every row, real download links and optional search.
docs: Every Download is a plain anchor with the download attribute, and its name reads Download, then the title, the type and the size. Pass filename when the saved name should differ from the file on the server. searchable adds a field that filters by title, description, type and language and announces how many documents are left. Dates follow locale, and a date without a time is never shifted. Downloads are not routes, so there is no linkAs. The block is a client component because of the search: use it from a Server Component with plain data. labels are plain strings too, with {query}, {shown}, {total} and {noun} as placeholders, so they can cross from a Server Component.
